name: Mascarade
summary: A bluffing deduction game where players swap hidden roles and claim powers to collect 13 gold.
rules_text: Each player gets 6 coins and a face-down Character, with 0-2 extra characters in the middle. Characters present are tracked. The first four turns are forced blind swaps: the player takes their own face-down card and another face-down card and may swap them under the table without looking. On later turns you must do one: blind swap your card with another player's or a middle card without looking, secretly look at your own card, or announce you are a character in the game. Others clockwise may also claim that character. If no one contests, you use that power face-down. If contested, all claimants reveal; if someone actually holds it they use the power now, others pay 1 to the courthouse as a fine, then all turn face-down. If you revealed your character on the previous turn you cannot announce it and must swap. Powers move coins between bank, richest player, courthouse, etc. First to 13 gold wins; if any player hits 0 coins the game ends at once and the richest wins.
